Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild normocytic anemia (low hemoglobin) and poor glycemic control (elevated HbA1c), suggesting diabetes. Cardiac markers (NT-proBNP, troponin) are within normal limits. Renal, liver, and electrolyte parameters are unremarkable except for slightly low total CO₂, which may indicate mild metabolic acidosis. Iron studies are normal. No acute pathology is evident, but anemia and diabetes require clinical attention and follow-up.
